How is it? Do I look good? I was young when I\njoined the troop and I've never done anything else\nother than the duties as a warrior before...
However here, selling supplies to various people\nincluding the troops that are coming later and the\nreinforcements is also an important duty...
I need to get used to it quickly.\nWould you come to buy supplies sometimes and allow\nme to practice my selling skills with you, please?
Welcome. Is there anything you need?\nPlease pick and bring the things you want here.
Thank you for buying.\nPlease come anytime if you need anything.

[ffff64]Dikkit Sector[ffffff]
Seems like Coenubia hasn't invaded this place.\nLet's make it our front line base to recapture\nEldenbaum.
But first, let's check every single corner for our\nsafety!
Oh, thanks for your hard work!...Yes, this is the\nSupply Depot. Not as good as El Scaro's general\nstore, but please come if you need something...
Yes, I'm in charge of selling the supplies here.\nNice to meet you!
Ooh, thanks for helping to check this place...\nThis is an arsenal. Doesn't appear to have been\nransacked, the weapons are spotless. It's great...
What? Oh, no, let's not touch them.\nLet's keep them for the reinforcement troops that\nare coming later.
Yo! Look! Lots of food is kept here!\nAnd everything has a long shelf life.\nIf it's just us, we'll be good for 3 years...
What? I know. Save some for the reinforcement\ntroops that are coming later, right? I won't be\nable to finish this much food at once either.
Conclusion, there's no spoiled food or monster!\nLet's report to the captain and the rest!
Hey, wait...\nWe won't be able to clearly see what's in front of\nus from here...
Yo! What's wrong?
Yo! What's wrong? Wow...!\nWhat's that creepy mist?!
The mist doesn't seem ordinary...Besides,\nit's somewhere above Fractum Sector here, which\nmeans beyond the mist is...
Hmm...you're right. Beyond such mist there's a\nquite terrible th...
Hmm...you're right. Beyond such mist there's a\nquite terrible th...Wait! Do you mean the\nCoenubia's nest that was visible from Fractum?!
Geez! Holy cow...!\nBut that's possible because below us now is...
Morthell and Labilans...\nNow it's clear where the Coenubia monsters in\nthose areas came from...
It's unbelievable that such place is very close\nfrom the first line base...But this also means\nthat it's easier to clear it...
Well, as a strategy to strengthen the defense of\nthis place, we should fix the damaged parts and\nbuild a new fence...
So all warriors please start repairing the parts\nthat can be fixed with the materials we have now.
And for the adventurer and Pelulu, could you\ngather the materials for the large-scale repair\nand the fence from the places we've passed before?
What a slave driver, we're not even warriors...\nHey, turn him down...
Yes? Did you say something?
Ah, er, nope, nothing! We'll go!!
Ooh, thanks for your hard work...
Ooh, thanks for your hard work...Um? Hmm, we just\ndiscussed that together with the reparation and\ndefense enhancement,
there's a need to stop the proliferation of\nCoenubia in Morthell and Labilans for the sake of\nthe reinforcement troops that are coming later...
So, the decision is if there's really Coenubia's\nnest beyond the mist, we should raid it now.
You seem to know a lot about the nest.\nWould you help us?
Ya! Don't worry about the reparation and the\nfence. I, Gondrum the Chief Sapper, will take care\nof them properly!
Lemme join you!! Many things had happened between\nme and Coenubia, lemme settle everything here!
All right then, let's rest for today. Tomorrow\nwe'll begin by splitting up into two teams, the\nrepairs team and the Coenubia's nest raider team!
Well, I'll leave the work to repair and enhance\nthe defense of this area to you. I'm counting on\nyou...
Ya! Be careful, captain! You guys too!!
Hmm...Didn't notice that we have way fewer\nsoldiers now than before...
You're right. But luckily, everyone's alive. Since\nmany retreated due to wounds, we have far fewer\nwarriors now compared to when we left El Scaro...
Relying on just our unit to recapture Eldenbaum is\nalready hard from the beginning, even with your\nhelp...
The reinforcements should be on their way too now,\nbut after what we've gone through, I'm afraid not\nmany would make it here...
We should secure more areas to welcome as many\ntroops as possible...
Where are they coming from?
They seem to be taking the sea route from the\nport in Sofya.
You mean they're sailing?!\nBut how are they gonna get to the top of this\ntree?!
Are you really a merchant? How come you don't\nknow? There's a branch that juts out into the sea\nand there's a big harbor called Haufen.
What? There's a sea? And a harbor?? What's the\naltitude of Eldenbaum and the surrounding lands\nand how are they exactly positioned???
Forget it. I don't think you would get it even if\na great professor explains it to you.
What's important now is to make sure the\nreinforcements could arrive at Haufen Harbor\nsafely.
Let's head to Haufen Harbor to get it back!\nMaybe some of the facilities there need fixing.\nGondrum, come with me!
Ya! I've more or less finished repairing and\nbuilding the fence here too, lemme go with you!
The harbor is destroyed, plus the water is gone...\nHow are we supposed to call in reinforcements?
Hmm...it's not efficient, but for now we can only\nget them to come through the way we have passed\nthrough so far...
Wait a sec. There's still one more way...
It's Triel...oops, I mean Triet!!\nWhat brings you here?!
I admire you guys for accepting King Elbano's\norder and working so hard for it.
I'm not sure what I can do, but you guys seem to\nbe in trouble and are yet to receive help from the\nreinforcement troops, so I would like to help...
Miss Lufenas, we appreciate your courtesy, however\nI'm afraid with you alone, our task force won't...
I didn't say that I wanna fight together with you.\nI want you to come with me to the Old Lufenas\nMansion Ruins ahead of us...
Lufenas Mansion...you mean there's another one\nbesides the one in Ultimea?
Yes...the Lufenas Mansion was originally built on\nEldenbaum during the foundation of the\nDarkan Kingdom, but then
things got cramped and a new mansion was built on\nthe hill near Eldenbaum.
That's also the current Lufenas Mansion that\nyou guys saw. It was moved to Ultimea due to\nthe cataclysm.
I read about our ancestor, Deltzon, that invented\nsomething that can teleport humans and things from\nsome old documents the other day.
If we use that, we can just directly transport the\nreinforcement troops safely and instantly from\nEl Scaro without getting attacked!
I see...So that means that teleporter is in the\nOld Lufenas Mansion?
Yes. I heard Deltzon's inventions remain in the\nbasement of the old mansion ruins. Would you\nguys come with me to get the teleporter to work?
Since the reinforcement troops can no longer get\nhere through the sea, the number of troops that\ncan be transported depends on the teleporter...
I got it! Let's go!!\nGondrum, we might need to fix the thing.\nSo you're coming with us!
Okay! Since I've never seen it, I'm not sure if\nI can fix it tho. But, let's just see!!
Yo! I'm glad that you're okay.\nThe teleporter is working fine too. It's all good!
But King Elbano, still...\nI was so surprised when you popped out of it...
I know right! I know you had a request to make to\nthe adventurer, but why did you try it out\nyourself despite not knowing it was safe...
It's a matter of transporting many Elf warriors.\nThe king's role is to make sure that it is safe...\nWhat's so strange about that?
H-how selfless...
Oh...now I'm ashamed of myself for getting\ncold feet...
You're such a noble king...
Now we can transport many reinforcement troops\nhere. I hope you'll put forth greater efforts to\nget Eldenbaum back!
Yes, your highness!!
Marching all the way here while battling Coenubias\nmust have been very tough.\nThank you...
With this many troops, I guess we're finally ready\nto reclaim Capital City Elban! We'll launch a\nmajor offensive in Capital City Elban...
But, keep one thing in mind.\nNever think of sacrificing your life just to get\nthe capital back. Stay alive! It's an order!!
A capital or a country is merely a container for\nhumans...No matter how great it is, one shouldn't\ndie for it!
If you sense danger, do not hesitate to retreat,\nyou understand?
Yess!!
Everyone, get ready to attack!!
Alright, just as planned. While we're distracting\nthe Coenubias, you guys charge into the capital\nright away.
Head to the Coenubia's headquarter in Eldenbaum\nfrom the Magic Research Institute.
Ya! Let the fighting spirit burn bright!\n...Phew...But it's sad that we have to part ways.
Thanks guys! Since we've come this far, we all\nshould play our part and do everything we can.\nLet's do our best!
We don't know the situation in Capital City Elban\nright now. Please be careful!
We'll go first and we'll be waiting for you guys\nto come with the reinforcements...
But who knows, maybe we'll get the capital back\nalready before you guys even get to us!
Darn it! Remember what you said! Just you watch!\nWe'll catch up to you guys in no time!!
You guys have been doing so well so far.\nI believe you'll definitely open the way to\nCoenubia's headquarter. We're counting on you...
Alright, we need to get ready too!
Yo! Long time no see!
Oh! The wanderer and the leader of the\nEthos Fortress! What brings you here?!
King Elbano seemed to have sent a petition for\nreinforcements to Pino.
So the soldiers from the fortress and Straye\nvolunteers rushed here.
I-I guess things have gotten serious...
By the way, where are you guys heading to?\nIt seems that you guys and the Elf warriors\nsplit up...
There seems to be a creature that possesses a very\npowerful force inside Eldenbaum's trunk.
So while the Elf warriors are distracting the\nCoenubias, we will try to find a way to get inside\nthe trunk. We plan to enter Capital City Elban...
It's too dangerous to head there by yourselves.\nLet me and Balsette join you. I'll command the\nfortress soldiers to cover us from behind.
We don't want them to notice us, but I was kinda\nworried too if it's just the two of us...\nI'm glad you guys are coming.
Alright, let's head to Elban then...
Oooh! There you are! Heyy!!
Yarn! Mondan! It's been a while!!
Yeah, it's been a while!\nWe, Pax Technista, will be joining you guys too.
It's fine right?\nI think we'll be useful, don't you think so?

Ooh, you guys are back! Getting Eldenbaum back\nwith just the two of you is amazing...I'd love to\npraise you, but I'm too moved to think of words...
One thing I can say for sure is you guys are\ndefinitely heroes!!
No, no, it's not like that!\nHad it been just the two of us, it would have been\nimpossible!
Various people helped us. Moreover, thanks to the\ndragon that rushed to us when we were in a jam and\nvarious gods,
we were able to defeat Coenubias. Well, I admit\nthat it was an exceptionally rare experience.
I was also able to meet Oritius again.\nPerhaps it was your extraordinary efforts that\npulled off the miracle. Thank you.
The people who gathered to reclaim Eldenbaum are\ncurrently resting here.
I guess you didn't really have the chance to chat\nproperly during the battle. I hope you guys can\nhave a good chitchat with one another...
Yo! You guys are back!!\nCongrats for crushing Coenubias!\nAlso thanks for getting Eldenbaum back!!
I wish I could see you performed at close range...\nObviously it's a splendid achievement.\nThat's a compliment from us.
Fabulous!! You guys are too awesome!\nYou really managed to get Eldenbaum back before\nwe caught up to you...
Welp, I'm a girl of my word.\nWe only did what we told you we would before we\nparted ways.
Holy cow! That's so cute of you!!
Captain Garrador, do you need help\nin repairing the...\nOooh, it's you guys!!
Congrats for crushing Coenubias! By the way,\nperhaps it was when you guys were confronting\nthe Coenubias,
Balse...I mean Oritius had a bad feeling and he\njust disappeared from my sight.\nCould he have gone to look for you?
Oh, no, he didn't come to look for us, but he went\nto the gods shrine instead.
He felt that the divine energy there is weakening\nand he wanted to restore it. So after a discussion\nwith Dunkelis, he went to the Dark Realm.
But he wanted me to tell you that although he's\ntraveling far for some time, he would definitely\ncome back to see you, Captain.
I see, so he went to the Dark Realm...\nThat's really far. But given the circumstances...
Wait? You aren't that surprised, are you?
Nothing's more surprising than knowing your close\nfriend who helps you and the fort soldiers all the\ntime was actually one of the 12 Holy Gods.
Besides, he's a wanderer.\nI know he'd come back before long...
By the way, Gondrum was involved in an explosion\nincident at the Ruins of Magic Research Institute\nand he rescued 3 Technista people...
Ya! And they talked so much! Despite getting hurt\nquite badly, the three of them kept on arguing and\nshouting at one another. It gave me a headache...
But at some point, they were talking about you,\nso maybe you know them.\nThey're over there, why don't you go take a look?
3 Technista people?...!!\nSo you found them at the Ruins of Magic Research\nInstitute?
I think we know them.\nThanks, we'll go check them out!
You guys are alive?!
Ooh, you guys came back!\nReally, I thought I was gonna die!
Soon after you left the Ruins of Magic Research\nInstitute, the Coenubia monsters caused an\nexplosion and we got trapped under the debris.
You should have run when I was holding the\nmonsters. It was all because you were trying to\nact cool by trying to help! You silly leader!!
Whaaatt?! Mondan and I only jumped in because you\nweren't strong enough to handle them! You were to\nblame for getting all of us buried in debris...
Argh, not again, shut up!! How many more times\nwill you argue about the same thing!!
Argh, not again, shut up!! How many more times\nwill you argue about the same thing!!
Well, well, isn't it a good thing that you all act\nlike you always do? That's just the way you are.
Since you guys came back, does it mean...\nWhat about Eldenbaum?!
We got it back. Aren't we great?
What?! Already?!
Oh noo!\nI wanted to take part in it too!!
See, I told ya! You should have just rushed to\nthem while I was holding the monsters!
Whaat?! That's because you did a half-ass job\nholding the monsters...!
Staahp!! Told ya not to argue over the same thing\nagain and again!
Oh, right, I completely forgot...
Yeah, where have you been all this time?\nYou need to explain everything!\nHey, York, are you listening?
Whoops! Errr...um...
Okay, okay, you guys don't have to corner him like\nthat. Everyone has their own embarrassing stories\nfrom their journey, no one enjoys getting teased!
What? I don't think such thing is a\nbig problem tho...\nWelp, not sure tho.
Yeah...just tell us. If it's really a hilarious\none, it'll just make us burst into laughter when\nwe recall it again.
...Sorry...
I know people say the more you fight, the closer\nyou get, but please do it in moderation.\nLet's see each other again somewhere!
...While you all live by different personal\nvalues, you all helped to recapture Eldenbaum.\nI'm so grateful for that...
That's the never-changing kindness of the people\nof this world. And...
At times, people like you show up to\nremind us of that...\nI thank you from the bottom of my heart.
Let me thank you guys once again for recapturing\nEldenbaum. Have a good rest today!
I'd like you to come to El Scaro to report the\ndetails someday later. Can I ask that?
